name: Contractor Report of Employee Arrest, Conviction, or Abuse Finding
description: When a contractor learns a contractor employee was arrested, convicted, or named a perpetrator in a founded or indicated report, it must report that in writing to the Superintendent.
quote: If the independent contractor receives notice of such arrest or conviction or that the contractor employee has been named as a perpetrator in a founded or indicated report, from either the contractor employee or a third party, the independent contractor shall immediately report, in writing, that information to the Superintendent or designee.
